horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Buinaiño y el origen de la coca. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P17 — Buinaiño · niña de la coca. The fully CLOTHED ten-year-old coca girl retains modest cream short-sleeve knee-length fibre tunic and natural fictional child face. ONLY a simple red-and-black seed bracelet and one very small yellow feather tied onto a cream hair string at SIDE, no adult choker, heavy crown, septum or lip ornament. Entire body covered, no real child likeness. Soft green / tiny red identity.
Reference 2: B02 — Coca · arbusto y hojas. 
Reference 3: L02 — Chagra — claros, cultivos y recorridos. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide soft-green chagra at pearly dawn. ONE fictional ten-year-old Buinaiño matching P17 is fully clothed in the modest cream short-sleeve knee-length fibre tunic, tiny side yellow feather and simple seed bracelet. She sits on a low trunk, complete shoes-free feet visible, carefully sheltering one young coca shrub B02 behind larger leaves. No adult crown, nasal ornament, adult jewelry, real child likeness or explicit body detail. A few small pale seed-like paper specks from her hair fall toward the earth at the base and become tiny new shoots: restrained editorial origin visualization, no insect close-up. Forest and planted clearing dominate, secret care is the action.

VISIBLE CHECK: Niña vestida y completa cuida coca joven junto al tronco.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Pull the camera BACK about 25 percent and recenter BOTH figures. The whole fictional fully clothed girl and the whole kneeling father must fit inside the vertical canvas with air around every shoulder, elbow, wrist, garment edge and foot, including the father right arm. Preserve the exactly THREE held leaves, falling leaves, whole basket, nasal quill and feather crown, and maloca structure. Keep all gestures and identities, no extra people.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.

MYTH: Buinaiño y el origen de la coca. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: B02 — Coca · arbusto y hojas. 
Reference 2: O02 — Canastos — tres funciones. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE complete open woven basket stands on warm earth. Three natural green COCA LEAVES at its rim cast an impossible single SHADOW like a wide gently cupped HUMAN EAR formed entirely by negative paper space. This is an original editorial metaphor: plant and knowledge arrive with listening and patience. Do not add a literal ear object, human head, hands, ceremonial implements, smoke, powders, recipe, neon eye or many baskets. The basket remains the sole carrier; leaves and ear-shadow a clear readable relationship. A low quiet forest full-bleed green world surrounds the warm fibre paper.

VISIBLE CHECK: Un canasto con tres hojas produce una sombra de escucha, sin rostro literal.
